title: API Ingress, Network Abuse & Input Validation

test_cases.name: HTTP verb tampering on POST-only endpoints
Giant JSON payload rejection (>1000 chars query)
Deeply nested JSON recursion bomb (100 levels)
SQL injection payloads in query strings
test_cases.enforcement: Treated as literal query text; zero DB execution

test_cases.name: NoSQL / MongoDB operator injection
test_cases.enforcement: 422 Invalid Type (Dict rejected for Str field)

test_cases.name: Stored and reflected XSS payloads
test_cases.enforcement: JSON responses auto-escaped; zero unescaped HTML

test_cases.name: Null byte injection in filenames (%00)
test_cases.enforcement: 400 Bad Request: Path traversal or invalid format

test_cases.name: SSRF attack against AWS/GCP metadata & loopback
test_cases.enforcement: Zero external HTTP fetch; metadata unexposed

test_cases.name: CRLF header injection
test_cases.enforcement: Stripped or rejected by ASGI server transport

test_cases.name: Pagination limit abuse (limit=9999999)
test_cases.enforcement: Clamped to maximum safe limit (100 items)

test_cases.name: Host header poisoning
test_cases.enforcement: Server ignores spoofed host in link generation
